set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set chassis fpc [parameter1].explanation: Sets the specified parameter for a Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) in the Junos chassis, configuring hardware-specific behavior or operational state.

pic [parameter2].explanation: This command configures a Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) and its associated Physical Interface Card (PIC) in a Junos device, specifying parameters for hardware settings.

t1-channel speed [parameter3].explanation: The command `t1-channel speed [parameter3]` sets the speed of a T1 channel to the specified value in `[parameter3]`, typically in kbps (e.g., 56 or 64).

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set class-of-service schedulers [paramet.explanation: The command `set class-of-service schedulers [parameter1]` configures a scheduler for traffic classes, defining parameters like bandwidth, priority, and buffer size for QoS management.

transmit-rate percent [parameter2].explanation: The command `transmit-rate percent [parameter2]` sets the maximum transmission rate as a percentage of the interface's total bandwidth, where `[parameter2]` specifies the percentage value.

buffer-size percent [parameter3].explanation: The command `buffer-size percent [parameter3]` sets the percentage of the total buffer space allocated to a specific queue or traffic class in Junos.

set class-of-service forwarding-classes.explanation: Configure the service category forward category.

parameters.name: forwarding-class
parameters.explanation: Forward class names for different flow categories.

set class-of-service interfaces [paramet.explanation: The command configures Class of Service (CoS) settings on a specific network interface (`[parameter1]`) to manage traffic prioritization and quality of service (QoS).

unit [parameter2].explanation: The command `unit [parameter2]` in Junos creates or references a logical interface (unit) with the specified identifier `[parameter2]` for configuration.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

output-scheduler-map forwarding-class [p.explanation: The command assigns a specific output scheduler map to a forwarding class, controlling traffic prioritization and bandwidth allocation for that class in Junos.

parameters.name: forwarding-class
parameters.explanation: Forward class names such as queue-1.

scheduler [parameter4].explanation: The `scheduler [parameter4]` command in Junos configures a scheduler policy by specifying a parameter (e.g., priority, buffer size) to control traffic handling in a queue.
